description: FOC planned a 14 May N’Djamena march to protest cost of living and dissolution of CONOREC; the Ministry banned it, and FOC subsequently said it was postponing to a future date. No body source reviewed establishes an executed FOC march or a separate/unauthorized gathering on 14 May.
required_followup: Only add an event if a permitted contemporaneous body source establishes actual gathering/execution and crowd size; do not infer non-occurrence or execution from the ban/postponement announcement.
